final: {"number": 998, "label": "question", "route": "answer", "related": [2588, 2757], "evidence": ["mockito/mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/Mockito.java", "mockito/mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/MockedConstruction.java"], "reply": "Hi Shreyas, Mockito can't stub a constructor. when(new URL(anyString())) runs the real constructor and passes its result to when(), so no stub gets registered. To get mocks created on constructor calls, use Mockito.mockConstruction(URL.class) inside try-with-resources, as described in the 'Mocking object construction' section of the Mockito Javadoc (since 3.5.0). It requires the inline mock maker. URL is a final class, so on 2.2.x you also need mockito-inline; since 5.0.0 the inline mock maker is the default. Mocking JDK classes like URL is limited, so see issue 2588 for that case."}
